I visited both websites, invited Dora to Slack using the email listed on her site, and sent both Dora and Eve feedback.

- **Dora:** Suggested adding a personal introduction and examples of her work or interests.
- **Eve:** Suggested adding hiking stories, trail recommendations, and practical tips.

Only brief text was available from each website, so I noted that I couldn’t assess their visual design.
